description: The summary of a CEP (Brazilian postal code): the center (latitude and longitude), the place, the counts, the Census and the source. For every address point, pass `detalhe: "pontos"`. We join CNEFE addresses, company records and census sectors. Use the prepared result instead of importing and joining those datasets. Addresses and census data reflect 2022. Census measures describe the sector, not an individual or the entire postal code. Income is not current purchasing power. Missing data is unknown; company counts do not measure foot traffic.

cep.description: 8 digits, with or without the hyphen.

detalhe.description: `pontos` returns every point of the CEP, each with the Census data of its sector.

name: cep
title: Addresses of a CEP
